steps.title: Open Claude Code
steps.body: Open the Claude desktop app and switch to Claude Code.

steps.title: Add an SSH connection
steps.body:
1. Click Local under the prompt box.
  2. Select SSH.
  3. Select Add SSH connection…
steps.alt: Screenshot · environment menu with SSH and Add SSH connection

steps.title: Enter the details
steps.body:
Name it Eggie, then copy each value from the card below:

  • SSH host
  • SSH port
  • SSH key
steps.alt: Screenshot · Add SSH connection form, filled in

steps.title: Save the connection
steps.body: Click Test connection and wait while Claude Code installs what it needs. When it says the host is ready, click Add SSH connection.
steps.alt: Screenshot · Test connection succeeded, Add SSH connection button

steps.title: Start prompting
steps.body: Pick the projects folder and tell Claude Code what to build.
steps.alt: Screenshot · Claude Code prompt, connected to the kitchen

steps.title: Open Claude Code
steps.body: Open the Claude Code app and sign in.

steps.title: Switch to WSL
steps.body:
1. Open the environment menu next to the prompt box.
  2. Select WSL.
  3. Choose eggie-vm from the list.

steps.title: Start prompting
steps.body: Tell Claude Code what to build.
steps.alt: Screenshot · Claude Code prompt, connected to the kitchen
